# thousandeyes_tests_dnssec (Data Source)

Get DNSSEC test.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

data "thousandeyes_tests_dnssec" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Each test is assigned an unique ID; this is used to access test information and results from other endpoints. Named `id` per the import convention; the wire field stays testId.
- `test_name` (String) The name of the test. Test name must be unique.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `alert_rules` (Attributes Set) Contains list of enabled alert rule objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_rules))
- `alerts_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if alerts are enabled.
- `created_by` (String) User that created the test.
- `created_date` (String) UTC created date (ISO date-time format).
- `description` (String) A description of the test.
- `dns_query_class` (String) Domain class used by this test. 'in' stands for Internet, while 'ch' stands for Chaos.
- `domain` (String) The target record for the test, with the record type suffixed. If no record type is specified, the test defaults to an ANY record.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Test is enabled.
- `interval` (Number) Interval between test runs in seconds.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Labels to which the test is assigned. This field is not returned for Instant Tests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `live_share` (Boolean) Indicates if the test is shared with the account group.
- `modified_by` (String) User that modified the test.
- `modified_date` (String) UTC last modification date (ISO date-time format).
- `randomized_start_time` (Boolean) Indicates whether agents should randomize the start time in each test round.
- `saved_event` (Boolean) Indicates if the test is a saved event. **Note**: **Saved Events** are now called **Private Snapshots** in the user interface. This change does not affect API.
- `shared_with_accounts` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shared_with_accounts))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags assigned to the test. Returned only when `expand=tag` is specified. This field is not returned for Instant Tests. For more information, see `/tags`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) This is a read only value, as test type is implicit in the test creation url.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--alert_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_rules`

Read-Only:

- `alert_type` (String) Type of alert being triggered. In multi-layered tests, this value represents the layer the alert relates to. See [Alert Details](https://developer.cisco.com/docs/thousandeyes/retrieve-alert-details/) documentation for a list of possible values
- `direction` (String) Direction for applicable alert types (eg. path trace, End-to-End (Agent) etc.)
- `expression` (String) String expression of alert rule
- `is_default` (Boolean) Alert rules allow up to 1 alert rule to be selected as a default for each type. By checking the default option, this alert rule will be automatically included on subsequently created tests that test a metric used in alerting here
- `minimum_sources` (Number) The minimum number of agents or monitors that must meet the specified criteria in order to trigger the alert
- `minimum_sources_pct` (Number) the minimum percentage of all assigned agents or monitors that must meet the specified criteria in order to trigger the alert
- `rounds_violating_mode` (String) `exact` requires the same agents to meet the threshold in consecutive rounds. `auto` is only enabled for CEA and Endpoint Scheduled test rules. The default is `any`.
- `rounds_violating_out_of` (Number) Specifies the divisor (y value) for the “X of Y times” condition.
- `rounds_violating_required` (Number) Specifies the numerator (x value) for the “X of Y times” condition
- `rule_id` (String) Unique ID of the rule.
- `rule_name` (String) Name of the alert rule
- `sensitivity_level` (String) Used when `roundsViolatingMode` is set to `auto`. The default is `medium`. Higher sensitivity increases the likelihood of triggering alerts.
- `severity` (String) The severity of the alert.
